QuestInfo.name: Tower of the Past
QuestInfo.0: The duo decided they would try to to stop time in #m327000000#... but how? They hoped that #b#p2470000##k would know how.
QuestInfo.1: #p2470000# told them to head into the #bEasternmost tower#k in #m327000000# to enter the past. They would then need to #btalk to the citizens there#k and capture their time flow in the #bempty bottle provided by Hera#k.
QuestInfo.2: The duo managed to stop time in the past Ludibrium.

0.0: You must eliminate the flow of time in both the past and future to stop it for all Ludibrium. Go to the #btower in the east#k.
0.1: You can enter the #btown's past#k through that tower. Once you're there, you'll need to gather the flow of time.

yes.0: It should prove quite easy for the two of you. #bSimply talk to the people in town#k to draw the flow of time away from them.
yes.1: I will give you an #bempty bottle#k to capture the time. It will keep the past in place.
yes.2: Use this #bempty bottle#k to capture the time you take away, and return it to me.

1.0: The bottle flows with time. Your trip to the past was successful.

yes.0: Mera is more skilled in future time than I am. Give her time to get ready.
